notesForSwitchDecision: gpt-5-family reasoning tokens are the bottleneck — avoid for user-facing time-sensitive flows.
Anthropic cache_read didn't drop wall time meaningfully (11.2s cold → 10.9s warm), because output generation still needs to happen.
gpt-4o hit ~3.3s consistently but returned slightly leaner directions (fewer secondary genres on some ranks).
Quality-wise all four outputs picked plausible jazz-forward directions for the wine-bar prompt. Sonnet's descriptions felt tightest; gpt-4o's felt shortest.
